title: 第二十五章 归尘
content_zh:
回程的路，比陈默预想的更难走。

    不是山路本身变得更陡峭崎岖，而是他这具看似恢复、实则千疮百孔的身躯，在脱离了石室那种近乎“静止”的温养环境，重新承受跋涉的压力时，各种隐藏的伤势和虚弱，如同潮水般涌了上来。

    左胸那道狰狞疤痕下的骨头，每一次呼吸起伏，每一次脚步震动，都传来清晰的、类似陈旧木器即将断裂的酸涩钝痛。膻中穴那新开的、微小的“缝隙”周围，气息流转时不再有冰火对撞的剧痛，却有一种空乏无力的、仿佛被掏空了一部分的隐痛和滞涩，让他的呼吸无法深长，稍快些便觉得气短心悸。左臂虽然恢复了基本活动能力，但经脉中残留的、被寒气与火毒反复冲刷后的损伤，让整条手臂都透着一种难以驱散的冰凉酸麻，提不起多少力气。右肩后背被赵明划出的伤口倒是愈合了，留下一道浅疤，但筋骨似乎也受了些暗伤，背着那个装着苏芸所赠药物、几件衣物和小荷一点干粮的简陋包袱，走不到半个时辰，便觉得肩膀酸沉，额头冒汗。

    更重要的是，他体内的灵力，不，此刻或许连“灵力”都称不上，只是那一缕微弱到几乎感觉不到、如同风中残烛般的水木气息。在石室中静坐行气时，尚能维持一丝微弱的循环，温养自身。但在这需要体力支撑的山路上行走，气息便完全散乱，几乎无法有效引导。他能感觉到，随着体力消耗，那缕气息正变得越来越稀薄，仿佛随时会彻底熄灭。取而代之的，是身体深处泛起的、因气血两亏和根基受损带来的、深入骨髓的疲惫和寒意。

    他走得很慢。每一步都踩得极为仔细，避开湿滑的苔藓和裸露的树根，尽量让身体的颠簸减到最轻。额头的冷汗，很快湿透了鬓角，又被山风吹冷，黏在皮肤上，带来不适的凉意。嘴唇因失血和虚弱，呈现出一种不健康的淡紫色。

    小荷抱着她的小包袱，紧紧跟在他身后一步远的地方。她不敢靠得太近，怕打扰陈默，也不敢离得太远，眼神里充满了不安和担忧。看到陈默步履艰难、脸色苍白、呼吸急促的样子，她几次欲言又止，想伸手去扶，又怕唐突，只能更加小心地注意着脚下的路，尽量不发出大的声响，仿佛连自己的呼吸都放轻了。

    走走停停。每当陈默喘得厉害，或觉得眼前发黑、站立不稳时，便不得不找块略微平整的石头或树根坐下，歇息片刻。他不敢坐太久，怕身体彻底冷下来，更难以起身。只是闭目，竭力运转苏芸所授的呼吸法，试图平复紊乱的气息和心跳，积聚一丝微弱的气力。小荷便默默守在一旁，警惕地观察着四周的动静。

    山林依旧寂静，只有风吹过林梢的呜咽，和远处隐约的鸟兽鸣叫。但这种寂静，在脱离了石室那种与世隔绝的安全感后，却透着一股无形的压力。陈默的耳朵变得异常灵敏，任何一点异常的声响——枯枝断裂、草丛窸窣、甚至远处一声突兀的鸟啼——都会让他心头一紧，下意识地握紧怀中用布条缠裹的柴刀刀柄（苏芸离开前，将柴刀擦拭干净还给了他），体内那缕微弱气息也随之波动。

    他不知道赵明和李贺是否真的放弃了搜寻，是否将王炎之死归咎于他，是否正在某个暗处窥视。他也不知道，宗门对王炎的失踪调查到了哪一步。这种未知，像一片沉重的阴云，笼罩在归途之上。

    走走歇歇，原本只需大半日便能走完的山路，他们从清晨走到日头偏西，才终于看到了熟悉的景象——砍柴时常走的东岭山道，远处杂役院低矮屋舍模糊的轮廓，以及更下方青云镇升起的、被暮色渲染得有些温暖的袅袅炊烟。

    看到杂役院的影子，陈默心中非但没有松口气，反而莫名地沉重了一下。那熟悉的、破败的、充斥着汗味、尘土味和麻木气息的地方，曾是他挣扎了三年、一心想要挣脱的牢笼。如今，在经历了黑风涧的生死、石室的寂静蜕变后，再回到这里，竟有种恍如隔世、又无比真切的荒谬与疏离感。

    这里，是他必须回来的“根”，也是束缚他最深的“茧”。

    他停下脚步，最后在一块背风的岩石后休息了片刻，从苏芸给的干粮里掰了小块最硬的饼，就着皮囊里所剩不多的清水，慢慢嚼了，咽下。又取出苏芸给的“培元散”，倒出少许在掌心，用唾液送服。微苦的药粉滑入喉咙，带来一丝微弱的暖意，勉强驱散了些许深入骨髓的寒冷和疲惫。

    然后，他看向小荷。女孩的脸色在暮色中显得有些苍白，眼神里有回家的期盼，也有对前路的茫然和一丝不易察觉的恐惧——她毕竟亲眼目睹了王炎的死，经历了那可怕的绑架。

    “小荷，”陈默开口，声音有些沙哑，“前面就是杂役院。我送你到镇子路口。之后，你自己回家。记住，回去后，只说你那天进山采药，迷了路，后来被一个好心猎户所救，在山里养了几天伤，今天才寻路回来。其他的，一概不知，一概不提。尤其是……”他顿了顿，看着女孩的眼睛，“黑风涧，王炎，还有苏姑娘，一个字都不要提。如果有人问起我，你就说，在山里偶然碰到我在养伤，见我可怜，给我指了路，分了我一点干粮。明白吗？”

    小荷用力点头，眼圈微微发红：“我明白，陈默哥。我……我不会乱说的。苏姐姐和你救了我，我……我知道轻重。”

    “嗯。”陈默点了点头，没再多说。他知道小荷心地纯善，也经了事，应该懂得利害。他重新背起包袱，紧了紧衣襟，最后看了一眼暮色中沉寂的山林，和苏芸离去的方向，然后转身，向着山下杂役院的灯光，迈出了最后一段归程的脚步。

    将小荷安全送到通往镇子的岔路口，看着她瘦小的身影融入镇口零星灯火和归家的人流，陈默在原地站了片刻，直到再也看不见，才转身，向着杂役院侧门那条熟悉的小径走去。
content_en:
The journey back was more difficult than Chen Mo expected.
It wasn't that the mountain road itself became steeper and more rugged, but that his body, which seemed to have recovered but was actually riddled with holes, had various hidden injuries and weaknesses that came up like a tide when he left the almost "static" environment of the stone room and once again endured the pressure of the trek.
The bones under the hideous scar on the left chest, every time the breath rises and falls, every time the footsteps vibrate, there is a clear, sour and dull pain, like an old wooden tool about to break.Around the newly opened tiny "gap" in the Tanzhong point, there was no longer the severe pain of ice and fire when the breath circulated, but there was a dull pain and stagnation that was hollow and weak, as if a part of it had been hollowed out. It made him unable to breathe deeply and long, and he felt short of breath and palpitated if he breathed a little faster.Although the left arm has regained its basic mobility, the damage left in the meridians after being repeatedly washed away by cold air and fire poison has left the entire arm with a cold and soreness that is difficult to dispel, and it cannot lift much strength.The wound made by Zhao Ming on the back of his right shoulder had healed, leaving a shallow scar, but the muscles and bones seemed to have suffered some hidden injuries. Carrying the simple baggage containing the medicine given by Su Yun, a few pieces of clothing and some dry food from Xiao He, after walking for less than half an hour, his shoulders felt sore and his forehead was sweating.
What's more important is that the spiritual power in his body, no, maybe it can't even be called "spiritual power" at this moment, it's just a faint breath of water and wood that is almost imperceptible, like a candle in the wind.When sitting quietly in the stone room to circulate Qi, you can still maintain a weak circulation and warm yourself.But when walking on this mountain road that requires physical support, the breath is completely scattered and it is almost impossible to effectively guide it.He could feel that with the exhaustion of physical strength, the breath was becoming thinner and thinner, as if it would be completely extinguished at any time.Instead, there is fatigue and chill deep in the body caused by the loss of Qi and blood and damage to the foundation, which penetrates into the bone marrow.
He walked very slowly.Every step was taken extremely carefully, avoiding slippery moss and exposed tree roots, and trying to minimize the bumps on the body.The cold sweat on his forehead quickly soaked his temples, and was blown cold by the mountain wind, sticking to his skin, bringing an uncomfortable chill.The lips took on an unhealthy lilac color from blood loss and weakness.
Xiaohe hugged her little bundle and followed closely one step behind him.She didn't dare to get too close for fear of disturbing Chen Mo, nor did she dare to stay too far away. Her eyes were full of uneasiness and worry.Seeing Chen Mo's difficult steps, pale face, and shortness of breath, she hesitated several times and wanted to reach out to help, but she was afraid of being rude, so she could only pay more careful attention to the road under her feet, trying not to make loud noises, as if she was even breathing lightly.
Stop and go.Whenever Chen Mo was out of breath, or felt that his vision was getting dark and he was unsteady on his feet, he had to find a slightly flat stone or tree root to sit down and rest for a while.He did not dare to sit for too long, fearing that his body would become completely cold and it would be even more difficult to get up.He just closed his eyes and tried his best to use the breathing techniques taught by Su Yun, trying to calm the chaotic breath and heartbeat, and gather a weak strength.Xiao He stood aside silently, watching the movements around him vigilantly.
The mountain forest is still silent, with only the whine of the wind blowing through the treetops and the faint chirping of birds and animals in the distance.But this kind of silence, after breaking away from the isolation and security of the stone room, reveals an invisible pressure.Chen Mo's ears became extremely sensitive. Any unusual sound - the breaking of dead branches, the rustling of grass, or even the sudden cry of a bird in the distance - would make his heart tighten. He subconsciously clenched the handle of the hatchet wrapped in a strip of cloth in his arms (Su Yun wiped the hatchet clean and gave it back to him before leaving), and the weak breath in his body also fluctuated.
He didn't know whether Zhao Ming and Li He really gave up the search, whether they blamed Wang Yan's death on him, or whether they were peeping in a dark place.He also didn't know how far the sect had gone in investigating Wang Yan's disappearance.This unknown, like a heavy cloud, hangs over the journey home.
After walking and resting, the mountain road that originally only took half a day to complete, they walked from early morning to the west, and finally saw a familiar sight - the Dongling Mountain Road often used for cutting wood, the vague outline of the low-rise houses in the courtyard in the distance, and the rising smoke from Qingyun Town further down, which was warmed by the dusk.
Seeing the shadow of the courtyard, instead of letting out a sigh of relief, Chen Mo's heart felt inexplicably heavy.That familiar, dilapidated place, filled with the smell of sweat, dust and numbness, was once the prison from which he struggled for three years and wanted to break free.Now, after experiencing life and death in the Black Wind Stream and the silent transformation of the stone chamber, when I return here, I feel a sense of absurdity and alienation that feels like a world away, yet is extremely real.
Here is the "root" that he must come back to, and it is also the "cocoon" that binds him the deepest.
He stopped and finally rested for a while behind a rock in the lee. He broke off a small piece of the hardest cake from the dry food Su Yun gave him, chewed it slowly and swallowed it with the little water left in the bag.He also took out the "Peiyuan Powder" given by Su Yun, poured a little into the palm of his hand, and drank it with saliva.The slightly bitter medicinal powder slid into the throat, bringing a faint warmth and barely dispelling the coldness and fatigue that had penetrated into the bone marrow.
Then, he looked at Xiao He.The girl's face looked a little pale in the dusk. There was a desire to go home in her eyes, but also a confusion about the future and a subtle fear - after all, she had witnessed Wang Yan's death and experienced the terrible kidnapping.
"Xiao He," Chen Mo said, his voice a little hoarse, "there is the handyman's yard ahead. I will take you to the intersection of the town. After that, you can go home by yourself. Remember, when you go back, you will only say that you went into the mountains to collect herbs that day and got lost. Later, you were rescued by a kind-hearted hunter. You recovered from your injuries in the mountains for a few days before you found your way back today. Others,Don't know anything, don't mention it at all.Especially..." He paused and looked into the girl's eyes. "Don't mention anything about Hei Fengjian, Wang Yan, and Miss Su.If anyone asks about me, just say that you happened to meet me in the mountains while I was recovering from my injuries.You showed me the way and gave me some food."
Xiaohe nodded vigorously, his eye circles slightly red: "I understand, Brother Chen Mo. I...I won't talk nonsense. Sister Su and you saved me, I...I know the severity."
"Yeah." Chen Mo nodded and said no more.He knew that Xiao He had a pure heart and had experienced things, so he should know the pros and cons.He picked up his baggage again, tightened his clothes, and took one last look at the silent mountain forest in the dusk and the direction Su Yun was leaving. Then he turned around and took the last step back towards the lights of the yard at the foot of the mountain.
After safely delivering Xiao He to the fork in the road leading to the town, and seeing her thin figure blending into the scattered lights at the entrance of the town and the flow of people returning home, Chen Mo stood there for a moment until he could no longer see her, then turned around and walked towards the familiar path at the side door of the courtyard.
